LESSON: HADITHI

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.19: Hadithi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Hadithi. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kusikiliza hadithi ikisomwa na mwalimu kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha usomaji na usikivu
2. kusoma hadithi kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 93
3. kufahamu hadithi aliyoisoma na aliyosomewa kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe e) kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi. Kuandika ( Vipindi 3)
4. kuandika kisa kifupi kwa hati nadhifu kulingana na mada ili kujenga stadi ya uandishi
5. kufurahia uandishi wa visa tofauti ili kuimarisha mawasiliano andishi. mada. Kisa hiki kifuate hatua tano za uandishi: maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, marejeleo, uhariri na uchapishaji. Sarufi: Ukanusho wa nyakati

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kusikiliza hadithi ikisomwa na mwalimu kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha usomaji na usikivu
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusikiliza hadithi ikisomwa na mwalimu kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha usomaji na usikivu. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma hadithi kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 93
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma hadithi kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 93. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kufahamu hadithi aliyoisoma na aliyosomewa kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe e) kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi. Kuandika ( Vipindi 3)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kufahamu hadithi aliyoisoma na aliyosomewa kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe e) kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi. Kuandika ( Vipindi 3). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kuandika kisa kifupi kwa hati nadhifu kulingana na mada ili kujenga stadi ya uandishi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuandika kisa kifupi kwa hati nadhifu kulingana na mada ili kujenga stadi ya uandishi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

5. kufurahia uandishi wa visa tofauti ili kuimarisha mawasiliano andishi. mada. Kisa hiki kifuate hatua tano za uandishi: maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, marejeleo, uhariri na uchapishaji. Sarufi: Ukanusho wa nyakati
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kufurahia uandishi wa visa tofauti ili kuimarisha mawasiliano andishi. mada. Kisa hiki kifuate hatua tano za uandishi: maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, marejeleo, uhariri na uchapishaji. Sarufi: Ukanusho wa nyakati. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadithi.
2. Explain Hadithi to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadithi.
4. Show that you can: kusikiliza hadithi ikisomwa na mwalimu kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha usomaji na usikivu
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Hadithi. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Hadithi important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kusikiliza hadithi ikisomwa na mwalimu kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha usomaji na usikivu
2. kusoma hadithi kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma 93
3. kufahamu hadithi aliyoisoma na aliyosomewa kuhusu kazi mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe e) kuchangamkia kusoma hadithi. Kuandika ( Vipindi 3)
4. kuandika kisa kifupi kwa hati nadhifu kulingana na mada ili kujenga stadi ya uandishi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
